changes.before: 我会从围栏外拍。也想让朋友站进去拍，可以在花前停下吗？
changes.after: 我会从围栏外拍。也想请朋友站好让我拍照，可以在花前停留一下吗？
changes.reason: Japanese asks friend to pose outside the fence; 站进去 implies entering the prohibited fenced area.

changes.before: 我會從圍欄外拍。也想讓朋友站進去拍，可以在花前停下嗎？
changes.after: 我會從圍欄外拍。也想請朋友站好讓我拍照，可以在花前停留一下嗎？
changes.reason: Japanese asks friend to pose outside the fence; 站进去 implies entering the prohibited fenced area.

changes.before: Do not try to let them through regardless; call me using the phone inside reception.
changes.after: Do not let the vehicles through if you cannot confirm the details; call me using the phone inside reception.
changes.reason: Render 無理に通さず naturally as withholding passage when confirmation is unclear, consistent with the radio failure context.

changes.before: Xin xem ghi chép và giấy tờ danh tính. Lần cuối dùng thẻ khi nào?
changes.after: Cho tôi xem thông tin đã ghi lại và giấy tờ tùy thân của bạn. Bạn dùng thẻ lần cuối khi nào?
changes.reason: Use natural Vietnamese for the account-number record and identity documents while preserving the staff request and last-use question.

changes.before: छ। भवन नाम लामो छ, कोठाबाहिर लेख्न मिल्छ?
changes.after: छ। भवनको नाम लामो छ, फारमको कोष्ठबाहिर पनि लेख्न मिल्छ?
changes.reason: Clarify that the learner asks to write outside the form field, not outside a physical room; retain the long building name context.

changes.before: ถ้าอย่างนั้นไม่เดินรอบ ไปแค่ก่อนถึงสระแล้วกลับค่ะ
changes.after: ถ้าอย่างนั้นจะไม่เดินรอบสระ แต่จะไปถึงริมสระฝั่งใกล้แล้วกลับค่ะ
changes.reason: The agreed route reaches the near bank of the pond; the previous Thai said to stop before reaching the pond, losing the scenery goal.

changes.before: 取出袋子，用烤麵包機短時間加熱，注意別烤焦。
changes.after: 把麵包從袋子裡取出，用烤麵包機短時間加熱，注意別烤焦。
changes.reason: The instruction is to remove bread from its bag before reheating; 取出袋子 literally tells the learner to take out the bag instead.

scope: AI Japanese context and all12 sentence/task sets; native/source/device approval separate.
